title: Use progressive literature retrieval batches
description: Prevents broad topic reviews from pre-queuing many slow searches before any evidence has been screened.
changes: Limit the initial interactive retrieval batch to one or two complementary queries.
Require screening the current batch before issuing a follow-up batch.
Limit follow-up batches to two queries and stop when evidence is sufficient.
Reserve exhaustive mode for explicit systematic-review requests.

rollback.notes: Restore retrieval routing without progressive batch limits.
